hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.css|*.json|*.md) if [ -f "$f" ]; then npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi;; esac
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /( |$)|rm -rf ~'; then exit 2; fi
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs your approval"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
